`final class TweenAnimator`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Float>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.animator` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TweenAnimator.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/animator/TweenAnimator.java)

Read-only `float` signal that a timeline of tweens moves over time, the usual way to animate a node.

## Description

A `TweenAnimator` is a [`Signal`](/reference/signals/signal/) of a `float` that you never set: a [`Timeline`](/reference/animation/timeline/) of steps moves it, and everything that reads it follows.
Use one for any motion or fade that plays over time: describe the steps with `sequence(...)` and `push(...)`, then call `start()`.
Read its value like any signal, in a node property, a `map(...)` or an `onChange` listener.
[Chain, repeat and replay](/use/learn/style-and-motion/animation/#chain-repeat-and-replay) starts one on a click.

## Property details

<a id="TweenAnimator-property-timeline"></a>

### timeline

- `this timeline(Timeline timeline)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Timeline getTimeline()` 

**Default:** `null`

The timeline that moves the value, or `null` when none is playing.
Setting another timeline kills the current one, and the next `update()` counts the time from that moment; give a timeline built from `tween(...)` to drive the animator with nested sequences and parallels.

<a id="TweenAnimator-property-speed"></a>

### speed

- `this speed(float speed)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `float getSpeed()` 

**Default:** `1F`

The factor applied to the elapsed time: `2F` plays twice as fast, `0.5F` half as fast, `0F` freezes the animation.
`clear()` sets it back to `1F`.

## Method details

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-update"></a>

### update

`this update()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Advances the timeline by the time elapsed since the start or the previous update, and stops the advance once per frame, then returns this animator.

`this update(float delta)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Advances the timeline by `delta` ms, multiplied by the speed, and stops the advance once per frame, then returns this animator.

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-isWritable"></a>

### isWritable

`boolean isWritable()` 

Returns `false`: only the timeline, `value(...)` and `clear()` change the value.

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-isAutomatic"></a>

### isAutomatic

`boolean isAutomatic()` 

If `true`, JOID advances the animator once per frame: from `start()` until the timeline ends, `clear()`, `value(...)`, `sequence(...)` or `update(...)`.

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-start"></a>

### start

`this start()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Starts the timeline from its beginning and lets JOID advance it once per frame, then returns this animator.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` without timeline, or when the timeline is invalid (a block left open, a repetition forever without duration).

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-copy"></a>

### copy

`TweenAnimator copy()` 

Returns a fresh animator with the value, the speed and the listeners of this one, `onChange` included, without its timeline; the two animators are independent afterwards.

`this removeOnChange(SignalListener<? super Float> listener)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

### sequence

`this sequence(float duration, float value)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Kills the current timeline and creates a sequence whose first step goes to `value` in `duration` ms, with a linear easing, then returns this animator.

`this sequence(float duration, float value, TweenEquation easing)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Kills the current timeline and creates a sequence whose first step goes to `value` in `duration` ms with `easing`, then returns this animator.

### delay

`this delay(float delay)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Adds `delay` ms of waiting before the timeline starts, then returns this animator.

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-repeat"></a>

### repeat

`this repeat(int count, float delay)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Plays the timeline `count` more times after the first, with `delay` ms between two plays, then returns this animator; [`BaseTween.INFINITY`](/reference/animation/basetween/#BaseTween-constant-INFINITY) repeats forever.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` once the timeline is started.

<a id="TweenAnimator-method-tween"></a>

### tween

`Tween tween(float duration)` 

Returns a [`Tween`](/reference/animation/tween/) of `duration` ms that moves the value of this animator, to place in a [`Timeline`](/reference/animation/timeline/) of your own.
